jobs.occupation: Control and Protection Commissioning Engineer for HVDC
jobs.description:
The opportunity
The quality and innovation of the engineering in our products, systems and service offerings keeps our customers ahead. Developing solutions for our customers all over the world and working on our market-leading technologies will challenge and enrich your work and your mind.
As a Control and Protection Commissioning Engineer you will be part of the HVDC unit. You will get involved in the later stages of system testing at Hitachi Energy premises and lead commissioning activities of Control and Protection and SCADA at customer sites. You will be part of the hand-over and trial operations of HVDC links, with a direct interface with customers and opportunities to travel globally.
How you’ll make an impact
Organize and execute testing and commissioning activities, including test equipment management.
Participate in technical discussions with clients and consultants.
Ensure full understanding of scope and division of work.
Communicate all changes to the Commissioning Manager.
Ensure customer commitments are met according to contract.
Support tender work related to commissioning scope.
Analyze disturbances during commissioning and operation.
Live Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity.

Your background
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
Experience in Control and Protection or SCADA from design or testing stages.
Experience in AC substations or HVDC technology.
Experience in commissioning work in plants of varying size and complexity.
Knowledge of MACH, IEC61850, HVDC projects or IED relay programming is an advantage.
Fluency in English.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy, both in Sweden and globally
Mentor support during onboarding
Various trainings and education supporting employee development
A diverse company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks
Additional benefits may apply to this specific role

Join Telavox as a Security Engineer 🔐
Are you a hands-on security engineer who enjoys being close to the code, the systems, and the teams building them? At Telavox, security is not a gate at the end of development. It is an embedded capability that enables us to move fast, safely, and at scale.
Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS across Europe and across the globe. As our platform grows, security becomes a force multiplier, not just protecting what we build, but actively enabling engineers to ship better and safer software every day.
We are growing our Security Engineering team and looking for a Security Engineer to join our engineering organisation. You will work side by side with our Security Engineering Lead, sharing the same mission and many of the same activities, and bringing your own depth and perspective to the team. Together you will make security a built-in property of every system we ship, by making the secure way the easy way for every engineering team.
About the job
As a Security Engineer, you are part of the engineering execution layer that makes security real across the Platform organisation. You work across product and platform teams, building paved roads, secure defaults, and standards that teams adopt as their own, instead of doing every team's security for them.
You are a close partner to the Security Engineering Lead, who sets direction and priorities for the function. You complement each other: you share the work, challenge each other's thinking, and divide focus areas based on where your strengths are deepest. You also help bridge the gap between the CISO's strategic direction and day-to-day engineering reality, turning security goals into concrete engineering outcomes.
Your day-to-day work includes:

Build and evolve paved roads that make secure choices the default, such as vulnerability management workflows, secrets handling, and secure-by-default patterns in CI/CD

Work cross-functionally with engineering teams, understanding their context and helping them adopt security improvements in a way that fits how they build

Own and evolve vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning across our code and services, and make sure findings actually get fixed

Translate risks and requirements from customers, operators, audits, and the risk register into concrete, sized work for the right teams, and follow up so it lands and stays landed

Triage and coordinate responses to emerging threats: assess severity, involve the right teams, and drive issues to resolution

Share ownership of the security roadmap with the Security Engineering Lead, and take clear ownership of the areas where your experience is strongest

The role is based either at our new HQ in Malmö or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You are a pragmatic, hands-on security engineer who enjoys working closely with engineering teams and across team boundaries. You are comfortable moving between code, tooling, and architecture discussions, and you care about making security scalable, practical, and usable. You are just as comfortable working independently as you are in a small team where you and a colleague share responsibility for a broad area.
You believe security works best when it is distributed, automated, and embedded, not bolted on in the end. You lead through explanation and good defaults rather than gates and approvals.
You think ahead about what embedded security looks like when engineering is increasingly AI-augmented: agent credentials, MCP and tool-use boundaries, and secure-by-default workflows for code that humans and models write together.
We are looking for someone with:

A hands-on background in software or platform engineering, with real comfort in the terminal, able to run scans, inspect output, and file a PR when needed

At least 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role

Demonstrated experience with the security tooling landscape, such as vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets scanning, understanding trade-offs, not just installation

Experience building shared tooling, standards, or paved roads that other engineering teams adopt

A teaching and enabling mindset: sharing knowledge, running hands-on deep-dives, and leaving capability behind rather than creating dependency

Strong ability to collaborate with engineers across teams, influence without formal authority, and translate security risks into practical engineering work

A collaborative way of working with a lead and peers, including sharing context, dividing focus areas, and giving and receiving honest feedback

Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus

Platform Team Lead
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time
The Role:
The Platform team creates the foundations that help Netlight’s builders start faster, ship safely, and work with confidence. Its scope spans cloud landing zones, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, service-catalogue capabilities, and AI tooling. We are looking for a Team Lead who can help a senior team turn these components into a reliable, easy-to-use platform.
You will protect the health of today’s services while helping the team invest in what comes next: production-grade cloud environments, clear self-service paths, stronger operational practices, and practical AI-assisted development. You will report to the Head of Tech and work closely with Operations and technical teams across Netlight.
At Netlight, the Team Lead role combines Engineering Manager responsibilities – people, technology, and business impact – with Product Manager responsibilities: problem discovery, stakeholder management, and prioritisation. You set direction, remove blockers, and make trade-offs visible. Goals, budget envelopes, and hiring decisions are shaped with the Head of Tech.

With your help, we want to:
- Make hard-won operational knowledge shared and documented, so reliability does not depend on one person’s memory.
- Develop Builder Experience Foundations into production-grade environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Build AI-platform tooling and workflows that help builders adopt AI-assisted development with confidence.
- Create clear standards, guardrails, and self-service onboarding so teams can build on solid foundations from day one.

Who you are
You can lead through ambiguity, turn competing needs into clear priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work.
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
- Strong prioritisation skills and a product mindset. You can balance operational requests, strategic investment, and team capacity.
- Experience building or running a platform as a product. You understand self-service, golden paths, service catalogues, clear ownership, and useful defaults – not only keeping infrastructure available.
- A self-directed, improvement-oriented mindset. You spot what can work better and turn that observation into focused action.
- A track record of advocating clearly for your team with leadership and stakeholders. You can challenge a commitment while keeping the conversation constructive.
- Strong communication skills. You explain technical trade-offs in business terms and turn business needs into choices engineers can act on.

Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:
- At least three years of experience leading software-engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, or a combination of these platforms. You do not need to be hands-on every day, but you should make informed calls and earn credibility with the team.
- A record of bringing structure to ambiguous, high-pressure situations and turning them into well-run operations.
- The ability to work from a Netlight office at least three days per week.
- Fluency in English.
- Swedish or German skills are a plus.

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar developer-infrastructure platforms.
- Experience working in a Developer Experience or Platform Building group, team, or area.
- Direct experience with AI coding assistants or custom LLM-based developer tooling.
- Familiarity with cloud cost governance or FinOps.

What you will do:
You will lead a small, senior platform team responsible for cloud landing zones, AI tooling, and builder-experience components including monitoring, CI/CD, and service catalogue capabilities. The team wants to invest more energy in cloud and builder infrastructure. Your leadership will help it do that while keeping shared services dependable.
You will work closely with the Head of Tech, Operations, and technical teams. Your key responsibilities will be to:
- Team leadership and development: Set direction, coach, and grow engineers. Build an environment where ideas, risks, and concerns surface early and feedback leads to action.
- Operational oversight: Maintain a clear view of cloud and builder-experience platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including GitLab and CI/CD. Build documentation and knowledge-sharing practices that make the platform resilient by design.
- Planning and execution: Shape the cloud-infrastructure and AI-platform roadmap. Balance stability work with the ambition to build strong builder infrastructure and guide the adoption of AI-assisted development tooling where it creates value.
- Communication and collaboration: Represent the team’s needs and constraints upward. Involve the team before making commitments that affect its scope, capacity, or working conditions.
- Culture and engagement: Build trust through consistency. Close the loop on feedback, follow through on commitments, and make room for different perspectives.

What we offer:
- The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry - and contribute to the continued growth of our thriving Stockholm office.
- Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
- Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
- A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
- Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
- Mental health & parental support offerings
- 30 days of paid vacation.

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
- Deutschlandticket
- Wellpass

Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
- 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
- Private pension savings

About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.

Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.

Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you passionate about driving innovation and working on groundbreaking 5G and 6G mobile communication solutions? Do you thrive in a flexible working culture, where new insights are championed, and you are encouraged to develop new skills? Then join Ericsson and our team in Stockholm, Sweden. 
 We are looking for an FPGA Developer within the Ericsson Silicon organization. You will work with dedicated engineers passionate about developing world-class Radio and RAN Compute products. You will contribute to the FPGA team by developing and integrating high-performance FPGA solutions. 
 As part of our global organization, you'll collaborate with talented teams across our different sites. We are committed to Agile principles, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and teamwork. 
  
 What you will do:
  Design and implement FPGA-based Radio and RAN Compute solutions. 
   Develop and optimize FPGA designs for performance, power and cost-efficiency. 
   Apply industry-standard tools and methodologies for FPGA development and implementation. 
   Stay up to date with relevant FPGA technologies, tools and development methods. 
   Document design specifications, test procedures and results. 
   Participate in design reviews and contribute ideas to improve FPGA solutions. 
   Develop testbenches and test cases for your FPGA designs, following functional specifications, agreed verification plans and Ericsson development processes. 
   Use functional and code coverage results to identify verification gaps and meet agreed coverage targets. 
   Debug RTL issues found in simulation and on hardware, together with other designers. 
   Collaborate with hardware, software, systems and integration teams across Radio and RAN Compute development to understand product requirements and contribute to efficient solutions. 
   Contribute to the continuous improvement of products, tools and processes. 
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or equivalent. 
   3–5 years of experience in FPGA/ASIC development, including RTL design and verification. 
   Solid knowledge of FPGA technology, design environment and methodology. 
   Hands-on use of FPGA design tools (e.g., Vivado, Quartus, or similar). 
   Proficiency in a hardware description language (HDL) such as Verilog or VHDL. 
   Working knowledge of interfaces and protocols such as DDR, AXI4, PCIe, SPI or I2C. 
   Scripting skills, for example in Python, Tcl or shell scripting. 
   Ability to create RTL testbenches to verify your own designs. 
   Familiarity with hardware architecture and digital signal processing. 
   Knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM experience is a plus. 
   An analytical, results-oriented approach with the ability to manage priorities and meet agreed commitments. 
   Good English spoken and written communication skills. 
   Self-motivation and the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with others. 
   Experience collaborating across teams and sites.

Key Requirements:
Degree in Quantity Surveying or Construction Cost Management. 
B.Sc. Construction Economics / Quantity Surveying with 4-5 years’ experience at Senior QS level
A proven track record in delivering complex projects on time and within budget
Chartered MSCSI / MRICS or embarking on the APC process
Time management and communication skills. 
Computer literacy and digital systems proficiency. Microsoft Office, Cubit / CostX, COINS
Reporting and administrative skills. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Through collaboration and effective commercial management, you will contribute to positive commercial outcomes and the successful delivery of projects.

Contract administration and contractual claims management skills. 
Tendering, estimating, and commercial analysis skills. 
Subcontractor management, valuation, and payment administration skills. 
Commercial reporting and analytical skills. 
Feasibility assessment and commercial advisory skills.

Develop, evaluate, and qualify new alloys, process technologies, and extrusion products
Develop and optimize alloy performance for mechanical and functional properties, extrusion productivity, and sustainability
Collaborate with production teams to establish process standards and best practices
Support customer projects with technical expertise and metallurgical guidance
Support root cause analysis and problem-solving for quality issues related to alloy selection, mechanical properties, and geometrical stability

Experience in aluminium extrusion, aluminium processing, or a metallurgical manufacturing environment
Practical experience with metallurgical testing and analysis techniques
Experience with automotive, building systems, industrial, electrical, or renewable energy applications is preferred

Fluent English and Swedish both written and spoken
Curious, data-driven, and motivated to solve complex technical challenges
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to combine deep metallurgical knowledge with practical manufacturing understanding
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
Able to work effectively with research, operational, commercial, customer, and academic partners
Focused on measurable improvements in product performance, quality, operational efficiency, and customer success

International collaboration and exposure across sites
A dynamic and hands-on technical environment
Autonomy and responsibility in driving process improvements
Travel opportunities and involvement in on-site operations

Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
Be part of the medical technology revolution – Neko Health is expanding and looking for talented assistant nurses to join our team. Are you ready for an exciting career where you can make a real difference? This is your chance to become part of our dynamic team and help shape the exciting journey ahead!
In this role you will be at the center of our mission. Based at one of our futuristic Neko Health clinics in Central Stockholm, your main tasks will be to carry out examinations, collect clinical research data, take blood samples, analyse blood samples, and handle administrative documentation. You will be a key person in ensuring the smooth operation and high quality of our activities. You will work closely in teams with other skilled medical operators and experienced professionals, but you will also have the opportunity to take initiative and work independently.
We are looking for full-time assistant nurses who are comfortable working a variety of shifts, including daytime, evening, and Saturday shifts. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month.
Minimum Qualifications
Relevant healthcare education as an assistant nurse.

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Engineer  Industrial Control Systems
jobs.description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.
Denna position rapporterar till:
Digital Lead - Regional
__
You’ll join ABB Energy Industries, part of ABB’s Automation division. We deliver electrical automation and digitalization solutions to industries including nuclear power, district heating, hydropower, water, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, using ABB’s industry-leading technologies.
In this role, you’ll help deliver our cybersecurity portfolio and make a meaningful difference for our customers.
Your responsibilities
Design and implement secure OT solutions and interfaces with IT systems. Assess cybersecurity risks, identify security gaps and recommend effective remedies.
Develop robust system and network architectures.
Assess and document the cybersecurity posture of OT systems and network infrastructure.
Implement disaster recovery solutions for OT systems.
Deliver security updates and foundational security controls as part of service agreements.
Provide services such as IT/OT system hardening, role-based access control and risk assessments, helping customers meet cybersecurity standards and requirements, including the NIS2 Directive.

Your background
You have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field—or equivalent experience. Most importantly, you bring practical experience with cybersecurity solutions and services, as well as OT/IT architecture or infrastructure.
Experience implementing cybersecurity solutions for control systems and/or SCADA is an advantage.
You understand network maintenance and troubleshooting, firewall configuration, routing protocols and network traffic monitoring.
Knowledge of Network Intrusion Detection (NID) and/or Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) is a plus.
Certifications such as GISP or ISA/IEC 62443 (IC32 or IC33) are advantageous.
You communicate confidently in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

In this role, you will work closely with our executive management to drive strategic development, business growth and long-term value creation. It is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys complex challenges, turning insights into action and making a real impact.

The Role & Your Impact
As Group Strategy Specialist, you will drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process, working closely with our CEO, CFO and executive management to translate strategic ambitions into concrete plans and initiatives.
You will coordinate the executive management agenda, prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings, lead group-wide projects and support potential M&A opportunities.
Key Responsibilities:

Drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process

Coordinate the executive management agenda in collaboration with the CEO and CFO

Prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings

Lead strategic, group-wide and cross-functional projects

Learn lots about second hand in a fast-paced environment
Help to improve our service based on customer feedback

Requirements

Spoken and written fluency in German, at a near-native level
Good knowledge of English as this is our company language
An interest in finding solutions and improving the offer for our customers

Additional language skills (French, Czech, Danish or Dutch)
Experience in a customer-facing role
Experience in working in customer support via chat, phone and email
An interest in second hand

You get to
Be part of a modern company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will develop and work on meaningful challenges on a daily basis
Join a vibrant office culture at Medborgarplatsen
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues
Enjoy staff discounts at Sellpy and the H&M brands (Arket, COS, Other Stories, Weekday & more)
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform

On-site collaboration at our core, supported by a flexible hybrid setup. This specific role is based at our Medborgarplatsen office.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal structures, brackets and installation solutions, pneumatic components and installations, component packaging, and chassis integration. Experience in at least one of these areas is required, while broader experience spanning multiple areas is advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components, brackets, and installation solutions for heavy-duty vehicle chassis.
Produce and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5 and applicable design standards.
Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.
Develop solutions involving sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components, with consideration for manufacturing feasibility.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical and engineering documentation.
Provide technical support to production when required.
Independently plan and drive assigned design activities while contributing to technical knowledge sharing within the team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
CAD: CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or pneumatic system design.
Engineering analysis: Practical experience with tolerance analysis and the management of mechanical interfaces.
Vehicle integration: Understanding of component packaging, installation constraints, and chassis integration.
Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Development environment: Previous R&D experience involving heavy-duty vehicle development.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous research and development experience from heavy-duty vehicle development, hands-on CATIA V5 competence, and a strong background in sheet metal and/or pneumatic design. Previous experience with chassis design and installation for heavy-duty vehicles is advantageous, as is experience combining several of the relevant technical disciplines. The role requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Fluency in English is required.

jobs.occupation: Take your nursing career to Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Imagine building your nursing career in one of Europe’s most spectacular regions, surrounded by Arctic nature, close-knit communities and a healthcare system where your skills are truly valued.
We are recruiting EU-trained nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Finnmark, Northern Norway. You will mainly work within home care services or nursing homes, providing important care and becoming part of an experienced and supportive healthcare team.
Moving to another country is a big step, but you will not have to do it alone. We provide free Norwegian language training, assistance with authorisation, relocation support and personal follow-up throughout the entire process.
Your main responsibilities include:
Providing home nursing care to patients in their own homes
Working in a nursing home or assisted living facility
Daily patient follow-up, medication management, observation and documentation
Close collaboration with relatives, GPs and other healthcare professionals
Contributing to quality improvement and development of local routines

We are looking for someone who:
Has a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country
Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)
Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course
Works independently and in a structured way
Enjoys teamwork and has genuine compassion for patients
Is flexible and able to adapt to different work situations
Holds a driver’s license 

We offer:
A full-time permanent position
Competitive salary and working conditions
A warm, inclusive and supportive team
Opportunities for professional development
Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
Relocation assistance and help with housing
Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Why Finnmark?
Finnmark is Norway’s northernmost region and offers a different pace of life than larger cities. Here, you will find close-knit communities and easy access to nature.
Many international healthcare professionals choose Finnmark because of the combination of meaningful work, affordable living and attractive financial benefits. The region also offers unique experiences throughout the year, from the midnight sun in summer to the northern lights during winter.
As a nurse in the municipal healthcare services, you will play an important role in the local community and work closely with patients, relatives and colleagues in a supportive and collaborative environment.
Financial benefits of working in Finnmark:
Lower income tax rate (18.5% compared to 22% in the rest of Norway)
Additional annual tax deduction of up to NOK 45,000
No electricity consumption tax for households
Free kindergarten (meal costs may apply)
Additional child benefit for families with children
